components.name: AppShell
components.purpose: The frame of an app, built on Figma's AppShell patterns. From 1024px (desktops, iPad landscape) a desktop pattern: Sidebar · List-Detail · Top-Bar · Workspace · Docs · Focus · Grid, with Header/AppShell, panes, progress, a docked side panel and floating actions. Narrower, with mobile parts (phones, iPad portrait), a mobile pattern: the TopNavigation as a Bar, a Band with a hero, a Band-Sheet or over Media, then the Tab-Bar, a floating glass bar or an Action bar. Without mobile parts a narrow shell keeps its header and opens the Sidebar as a modal drawer. The Body pads Margin-Comfortable, so the page needs no Container for the margins.
